name: Codon Window Scan
description: Slide a 3-base window across an RNA sequence to extract codons. Each codon (triplet) maps to one of 64 possible values, encoding one of 20 amino acids or a stop signal. This is the first stage of in silico translation. The RNA_WINDOW_3 tile extracts aligned 3-base windows from the packed word stream; downstream BioTrix-to-Amino20 bridge tiles decode each codon to a residue. The three reading frames (offsets 0, 1, 2) are handled by three parallel window instances.
author: system

pipeline.note: Extract 3-base aligned windows at the given frame offset

expected_output: codon stream (6-bit values, one per triplet)
validation: AUG → start codon (Met). UAA/UAG/UGA → stop codons. Length/3 codons emitted per frame.
